latest_release.name: v0.29.9
latest_release.body:
### Removed

- `agent_cancel` tool. `agent_wait` without `timeout_sec` blocks the turn until
  the job finishes, so the model never got a turn to call it; hung sub-agents
  now run until the session closes, which cancels all live jobs.

### Changed

- Pickers now show a separator below the search field to distinguish filtering from results.
- `/code` now opens a searchable file picker, with filenames and directory paths
  in the shared name/description layout. Selecting a file opens the source viewer; explicit
  `/code path[:line]` and `/code @path` still work.

### Added

- The compaction marker in the transcript now expands to show the summary that
  replaced the cut history. Clicking the marker (or Enter, where the block has
  keyboard focus) reveals it, so a user can check what a compaction dropped
  instead of reading the session JSONL. Resumed sessions keep the same row ID,
  and the copy chord returns the marker line plus the full summary.

### Fixed

- Confirmed local branch deletion now uses `git branch -D`, so unmerged and
  squash-merged branches can be deleted without another confirmation.
- Long toast messages wrap to the terminal width instead of being cut off on one line.
- Session previews no longer cut CJK text mid-rune when trimming to the byte
  budget, which corrupted the terminal output of the sessions picker (garbled
  glyphs and misplaced rows). `TruncateBytes` now backs off to a rune boundary,
  so every display path emits valid UTF-8.
- Pasting into a diff review note now inserts text at the cursor and preserves line breaks.
- Close the original HTTP request body when reading it fails before retrying.
- `phi mcp list` now shows the configured URL for HTTP servers.
- Compaction rounds now carry the hook's `preserveData` through, so data a hook
  asked to keep survives when a later round runs on the same session.

### Security
